Mein Kampf ( German: [maɪn ˈkampf] ; lit. ' My Struggle ' ) is a 1925 autobiographical and political manifesto by Adolf Hitler , the leader of the Nazi Party . The book outlines many of Hitler's political beliefs , his political ideology, and his future plans for Germany and the world. Volume 1 of Mein Kampf was published in 1925 and Volume 2 in 1926. [ 1 ] The combined volumes encompass roughly 750 pages. [ 1 ] Emil Maurice , SS member No. 2, was prominent in early transcription, then most of the editing was done by Hitler's deputy Rudolf Hess . [ 2 ] [ 3 ]
